value.rationale: Group-law detectability is a natural exact invariant for the entire family of onto four-color words. The two abelian group laws agree in full spectra at n=4,5 and share rank, positive spectral gap and second moment at n=6, yet have different fourth moments/ordered additive energies at the exact first length n=6. The first separating invariant is mathematically motivated by additive quadruples and is not a tiny arbitrary parameter increment. The result is intentionally finite and self-contained.
